title: Sync-local tables
summary: Add the local-only state that supports baselines, aliases, pending deletion, review, and publication history.
produces: Baseline, ID-alias, pending-deletion, review-queue, and published-record tables
Privacy classifications and distinct lifecycle behavior for every table

conditions: Every new persisted field is classified on all privacy axes.
Baseline identity is keyed by record kind and record ID.
Each table's cleanup and restore lifecycle is covered by tests.
completion.summary: Schema-v32 sync-local persistence is implemented with lifecycle-safe repository operations.
evidence: packages/compendium_core/lib/src/privacy/field_registry.dart classifies every v32 column on category, subject, and egress axes; data_classification_coverage_test.dart passes.
sync_local_repository_test.dart proves baseline_entries uses the (kind, record_id) identity and same IDs across kinds coexist.

sync_local_repository_test.dart covers baseline reset, restore revalidation, detach cleanup, publication-history survival, transaction rollback, remap marker union, singleton epoch state, and idempotent review queueing.
